metaDescription: Order custom Gem personal protection equipment from Perfect Imprints. Bulk pricing on bandanas, masks, and sanitizers for your team.
introHtml: Gem-branded personal protection equipment offers a reliable way to keep your team safe while promoting your organization. From bandanas and masks to sanitizer gel packets and antimicrobial lanyards, Gem supplies practical PPE that stands up to daily use. Choose custom decoration options like screen printing or embroidery to add your logo. Perfect for safety managers equipping crews or HR directors preparing return-to-work kits.
